summary: Barnwell Industries filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, completing the sale of its remaining Hawaii development interests to David Johnston. The $1.77 million cash deal, agreed July 31, 2026, transfers BHP's 34.45% limited partner interest in KKM Makai, LLLP, 75% GP interest in KD Kona 2013 LLLP, and KD's project rights. Net proceeds are approximately $1.54 million after minority interest. The buyer is the son of Terry Johnston, a KD partner, and a potential 8% commission to Terry Johnston is indemnified. This marks Barnwell's full exit from Hawaii real estate, with corporate wind-up activities pending.
